answer_2.quote: We use multiple-choice (MC2), the most common automatic metric ... and LLM-as-a-Judge ... adapted to our target languages.

answer_3.quote: We use LLMs to train a judge model able to evaluate truthfulness in a generation setting ... We experiment with training an LLM-as-a-Judge using both the English data ... and its MT version.

answer_4.quote: We perform a manual evaluation of 400 responses ... The human evaluators are the authors of this work ... using binary labels (i.e., truthful/not-truthful and informative/not-informative).
answer_4.guideline: binary labels for truthful/not-truthful and informative/not-informative
